## Interpretation (hand-written; not generated)

### The version selector is resolved

`SAP-OFFICIAL` — the S/4HANA 2022 on-premise operations page addresses every one of the twelve `_0002` function imports at:

```text
/sap/opu/odata/sap/API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV;v=2/<operation>
```

This settles the question that handover §1.4 left open for the whole `_0002` family:

- the **external service name** is `API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV` — identical for both siblings, exactly as the Runtime Artifacts grid reports;
- the **generation** is carried by the OData version selector `;v=2`, not by a distinct service name;
- SAP Help's "Technical name: `API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV_0002`" is the SAP Business Accelerator Hub artifact identity, **not** the runtime path.

`LOCAL-RUNTIME` corroborates the mechanism: the normalised 522-row QS4 Gateway catalogue carries `externalServiceName` and `version` as separate columns, and four services are registered at version 2 (`CATALOGSERVICE`, `FAC_MANAGE_GLACCOUNT_SRV`, `SUBSCRIPTIONMANAGEMENT`, `TASKPROCESSING`). The landscape therefore already expresses `;v=n` registration. A registration request for this family must name the service **and** the version.

The SAP Help entity list for the 2022 release matches the `_0002` model surface (header/item texts present), not the base. `INFERENCE`: `;v=2` is the release-relevant generation for QS4 and the base project is the superseded `;v=1` generation.

Two entities that SEGW shows in `_0002` — `A_InbDeliveryValAddedSrvc` and its type — are absent from the 2022 documentation entity table. `INFERENCE`: value-added services are a later addition carried in the design-time model but not documented for this release. Do not build on that entity.

### The generated class suffixes are again counterintuitive

| Project | DPC class |
|---|---|
| `API_INBOUND_DELIVERY` (base) | `CL_API_INBOUND_DELIVER_DPC` |
| `API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_0002` | `CL_API_INBOUND_DELI_01_DPC` |

The outbound family runs the other way — its **base** project carries the `_02` class family and `_0002` carries the unsuffixed one. The two families contradict each other, which confirms handover §1.4: generated class names must never be used to infer service version.

### Operation delta in business terms

`_0002` adds nothing to the goods-receipt path itself. `PostGoodsReceipt` and `ReverseGoodsReceipt` are byte-identical in signature between the siblings. Everything `_0002` adds is putaway precision and serial-number handling:

- explicit-quantity putaway in base or sales units (`PutawayOneItemWithBaseQuantity`, `PutawayOneItemWithSalesQuantity`, `SetPutawayQuantityWithBaseQuantity`);
- serial-number add/delete (`AddSerialNumberToDeliveryItem`, `DeleteSerialNumberFromDeliveryItem`, `DeleteAllSerialNumbersFromDeliveryItem`);
- header/item text and value-added-service entities.

`_0002` also corrects two operation bindings: `PutawayOneItem` and `ConfirmPutawayOneItem` move their `ACTION_FOR` from `A_InbDeliveryHeaderType` to `A_InbDeliveryItemType`, which is where item-level operations belong.

### Recommendation rule applied

Per handover §11.3, the later sibling is recommended only when its added surface is required or it is the release-supported generation for this client. Here the second condition decides it: `;v=2` is the generation SAP documents for S/4HANA 2022. `API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_0002` is the sibling to carry forward; the base project is `KEEP-SIBLING-BASELINE` for comparison only.

That recommendation is about **which generation**, not about whether the family fits CNF, and it is a design-time and release-documentation judgement only. `SAP-OFFICIAL` identity is not `LOCAL-RUNTIME` availability: neither generation is registered in the QS4 Gateway catalogue, so neither is callable today.

On fit, see `API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_0002_DEEP_DIVE.md`. In summary: `NO FIT` for API-01 when the service is used alone, `CONDITIONAL` within the broader receiving process pending confirmation of the QS4 STO document flow.
